```{r association-tables}
# association's own report, knitted by the frame's report.Rmd with the functions of
# analysis/lib/rmd/report.R. It reads the tables this module published and nothing else.
#
# Each phenotype's two tables are association_<stem>.tsv and alleles_<stem>.tsv, the stem its name
# with every character outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] made _. They are read into one table each with the
# phenotype as a column, the site tables by data.table and for the columns shown. Phenotypes keep
# permutations.tsv's order.
phenotype_rows <- report_read("phenotype.tsv")
runs <- report_read("permutations.tsv")
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

phenotypes <- unique(runs$phenotype)
stem <- function(p) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", p)
site_rows <- as.data.frame(data.table::rbindlist(lapply(phenotypes, function(p) {
    sites <- data.table::fread(
        file.path(report_folder(), paste0("association_", stem(p), ".tsv")), sep = "\t",
        na.strings = "NA",
        select = c("kind", "chrom", "pos", "k", "n_observed", "S", "perm_p", "fdr_p",
                   "max_leverage", "zero_variance"),
        colClasses = list(character = c("kind", "chrom")), data.table = FALSE)
    sites$phenotype <- rep(p, nrow(sites))
    sites
})))
allele_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(phenotypes, function(p) {
    alleles <- report_read(paste0("alleles_", stem(p), ".tsv"))
    if (is.null(alleles) || nrow(alleles) == 0) return(NULL)
    cbind(phenotype = p, alleles, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
if (is.null(allele_rows)) {
    allele_rows <- data.frame(phenotype = character(0), kind = character(0),
                              chrom = character(0), pos = character(0), allele = character(0),
                              b1 = character(0), t = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
units <- max(num(runs$units))
SHOWN <- 20

# The site each allele row belongs to, and per site the allele with the largest |t|, or with the
# steepest slope at a flagged site, compared at six significant digits, where a biallelic site's
# two |t| differ only by rounding. Between alleles that tie, the one whose slope is positive.
site_key <- function(table) paste(table$phenotype, table$kind, table$chrom, table$pos, sep = "\r")
flagged_sites <- site_key(site_rows)[!is.na(site_rows$zero_variance) & site_rows$zero_variance == 1]
allele_key <- site_key(allele_rows)
size <- ifelse(allele_key %in% flagged_sites, abs(num(allele_rows$b1)), abs(num(allele_rows$t)))
strongest <- allele_rows[order(-signif(size, 6), num(allele_rows$b1) <= 0), , drop = FALSE]
strongest <- strongest[!duplicated(site_key(strongest)), , drop = FALSE]

# An ordinal phenotype's levels in the order its numbers give them, as phenotype.tsv wrote them.
level_order <- function(p) {
    rows <- phenotype_rows[phenotype_rows$phenotype == p & !is.na(num(phenotype_rows$value)), ,
                           drop = FALSE]
    paste(unique(rows$shown[order(num(rows$value))]), collapse = " < ")
}
# An allele longer than 20 bases, as its first 12 and its length.
allele_text <- function(a) {
    ifelse(is.na(a), "NA",
           ifelse(nchar(a) > 20, paste0(substr(a, 1, 12), "... (", nchar(a), " bases)"), a))
}
```

`r length(phenotypes)` `r if (length(phenotypes) == 1) "phenotype" else "phenotypes"` fitted over `r units` units: `r paste(report_text(phenotypes), collapse = ", ")`.

## The phenotype as it was read

```{r association-phenotype, results = "asis"}
for (p in phenotypes) {
    rows <- phenotype_rows[phenotype_rows$phenotype == p, , drop = FALSE]
    coded <- unique(rows$coded_one[!is.na(rows$coded_one) & nzchar(rows$coded_one)])
    table <- data.frame(Unit = rows$unit, Pool = rows$pool, "As written" = rows$shown,
                        "Read as" = rows$value, Fitted = rows$fitted,
                        check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    scale <- if (identical(rows$kind[1], "binary") && length(coded) > 0) {
        paste0(". The level coded 1 is ", coded[1])
    } else if (identical(rows$kind[1], "ordinal")) {
        paste0(". Each level is read as its place in the order ", level_order(p), ", from 0")
    } else ""
    report_table(table, caption = paste0(
        p, ", ", rows$kind[1], ", as each pool's cell was written and the number the fit used ",
        "(phenotype.tsv)", scale, "."))
}
```

## What the design can show

```{r association-design, results = "asis"}
# Every fit in a run has the one design floor its units allow.
limit <- suppressWarnings(min(num(runs$design_floor), na.rm = TRUE))
if (is.finite(limit) && limit > 0.05) {
    cat("**With ", units, " units, the smallest p any site can reach is ",
        report_number(limit, digits = 3), ", above 0.05.** The sites below are a ranking of ",
        "effect sizes and not a test.\n\n", sep = "")
}
labels <- paste0(runs$phenotype, ", ", ifelse(runs$kind == "snp", "SNPs",
                                              ifelse(runs$kind == "indel", "indels", runs$kind)))
measures <- list(
    "Units" = report_number(runs$units),
    "Rearrangements" = paste0(report_number(runs$permutations),
                              ifelse(runs$exhaustive == "TRUE", ", every one", ", sampled")),
    "Smallest p the design allows" = report_number(runs$design_floor, digits = 3),
    "Smallest p this run could report" = report_number(runs$floor, digits = 3),
    "Sites read" = report_number(runs$sites),
    "Sites tested" = report_number(runs$tested),
    "Selected, fdr_p \u2264 0.05" = report_number(runs$selected),
    "dispersion" = report_number(runs$dispersion, digits = 3),
    "depth_phenotype_cor" = report_number(runs$depth_phenotype_cor, digits = 3),
    "lambda_gc" = report_number(runs$lambda_gc, digits = 3),
    "Alleles a site, tested" = report_number(runs$arity_mean, digits = 3),
    "Alleles a site, selected" = report_number(runs$arity_selected, digits = 3))
table <- data.frame(Measure = names(measures), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (i in seq_along(labels)) table[[labels[i]]] <- vapply(measures, function(m) m[i], "")
report_table(table, caption = paste0(
    "What each fit assumed and absorbed (permutations.tsv). lambda_gc reads above 1 on a clean ",
    "table: compare it with the units and alleles a site was read in, not with 1."))
```

## The strongest sites

```{r association-sites, results = "asis"}
for (p in phenotypes) {
    rows <- site_rows[site_rows$phenotype == p & !is.na(site_rows$perm_p), , drop = FALSE]
    cat("\n\n### ", report_text(p), "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (nrow(rows) == 0) {
        cat("No site of ", report_text(p), " was tested: none was read in three units that ",
            "differ in it.\n\n", sep = "")
        next
    }
    # Ties in p go to the larger S, and every flagged site ahead of the rest in file order: its S
    # is not comparable between implementations.
    flagged_row <- !is.na(rows$zero_variance) & rows$zero_variance == 1
    rows <- rows[order(rows$perm_p, -ifelse(flagged_row, Inf, abs(rows$S))), , drop = FALSE]
    floor_p <- min(num(runs$floor[runs$phenotype == p]))
    # At the floor: the next p a run can report is twice it.
    at_floor <- sum(rows$perm_p <= 1.5 * floor_p)
    shown <- utils::head(rows, SHOWN)
    best <- strongest[match(site_key(shown), site_key(strongest)), , drop = FALSE]
    flagged <- !is.na(shown$zero_variance) & shown$zero_variance == 1
    kind <- phenotype_rows$kind[phenotype_rows$phenotype == p][1]
    coded <- unique(phenotype_rows$coded_one[phenotype_rows$phenotype == p &
                                             !is.na(phenotype_rows$coded_one) &
                                             nzchar(phenotype_rows$coded_one)])
    direction <- if (identical(kind, "binary") && length(coded) > 0) {
        paste0("in the units coded ", coded[1])
    } else if (identical(kind, "ordinal")) {
        paste0("further along ", level_order(p))
    } else "at the higher value"
    lead <- if (nrow(rows) == 1) paste0("The one tested site of ", p)
            else if (nrow(rows) <= SHOWN) paste0("All ", nrow(rows), " tested sites of ", p,
                                                 ", smallest permutation p first, ties broken by ",
                                                 "the larger S with a flagged site first")
            else paste0("The ", SHOWN, " sites of ", p, " with the smallest permutation p, ties ",
                        "broken by the larger S with a flagged site first")
    reach <- if (nrow(rows) == 1) {
        if (at_floor == 1) "It reaches" else "It does not reach"
    } else {
        paste(report_number(at_floor), "of the", report_number(nrow(rows)), "tested sites",
              if (at_floor == 1) "reaches" else "reach")
    }
    table <- data.frame(Sequence = shown$chrom, Position = report_number(shown$pos),
                        Kind = shown$kind, Alleles = report_number(shown$k),
                        "Units read" = report_number(shown$n_observed),
                        S = ifelse(flagged, "flagged", report_number(shown$S, digits = 3)),
                        "perm_p" = report_number(shown$perm_p, digits = 3),
                        "fdr_p" = report_number(shown$fdr_p, digits = 3),
                        "Strongest allele" = allele_text(best$allele),
                        "Its slope" = report_number(best$b1, digits = 3),
                        "Leverage" = report_number(shown$max_leverage, digits = 2),
                        check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    report_table(table, align = c("l", "r", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l", "r", "r"),
                 caption = paste0(
        lead, " (association_", stem(p), ".tsv), with the allele of the largest |t| at each, or ",
        "of the steepest slope at a flagged site, and its slope (alleles_", stem(p), ".tsv). A ",
        "positive slope means the allele is more frequent ", direction, ". ", reach, " the ",
        "smallest p this run could report.",
        if (any(flagged)) {
            " A flagged site's S is not comparable between implementations and is not printed."
        },
        if (anyNA(best$allele)) {
            paste0(" NA is a site alleles_", stem(p), ".tsv holds no row for: reportBelow and ",
                   "reportTop choose the sites it holds.")
        }))
}
```

## The p-values against the uniform

```{r association-qq, results = "asis"}
for (path in report_files("qq.png")) {
    report_image(path, caption = paste0("Every tested site's permutation p against the uniform, ",
                                        "a panel per phenotype (qq.png, drawn from the ",
                                        "association\\_ tables). The points sit on a ladder whose ",
                                        "ceiling is the design's floor."))
}
```

```{r association-manhattan, results = "asis"}
# The Manhattan plots in the order of the sequences they draw, each under the sequence's own
# name. A plot's file name carries the name with every character outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] made _.
plots <- report_files("manhattan_*.png")
if (length(plots) > 0) {
    cat("\n\n## Association along a sequence\n\n")
    sequences <- unique(site_rows$chrom)
    drawn <- sub("^manhattan_(.*)[.]png$", "\\1", basename(plots))
    which_sequence <- match(drawn, gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", sequences))
    for (i in order(which_sequence, drawn)) {
        name <- if (is.na(which_sequence[i])) drawn[i] else sequences[which_sequence[i]]
        report_image(plots[i], caption = paste0(
            "Association along ", report_text(name), " (", report_text(basename(plots[i])),
            "). A flat ceiling is the design's floor and not the data."))
    }
}
```
